Quantum 1.10.0 was certified on 2026-07-22. It pins **nucleus v1.6.0**, **quark v1.4.0** and **orbit v1.5.1**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.9.0: nucleus goes from v1.5.0 to v1.6.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.5.0 to v1.5.1 (patch) and quark stays at v1.4.0.
